integrity.claim_basis: analytic proof of exact positive weighted Parseval-frame budget, with finite supplemental checks

scientific_limitations: Only odd primes p and five consecutive spatial sites in a cyclic group of order 2p are addressed.
Selected character weights are strictly positive and generally unequal. All optimal supports are not enumerated.
No claims about noise stability, composite half-orders, or independent historical priority.
title: Eight positive Fourier samples suffice and are necessary on five consecutive sites of twice-prime cycles
